remarks: 2/1 multi-unit w/2 car garage located minutes away from Sunset Bay and Hidaway Bay Resort in Silver Creek. This property is perfect for an owner occupy or an airbnd since being so close to two well-known beach getaways. Many updates were completed from the previous owner that include maintenance free vinyl siding, newer windows throughout, PVC and copper plumbing, basement drain tile, electric service, HWT and furnace are less than 10 yrs old. The current owner had a complete tear off roof done in 2025. The lower level where the owner lives has a wide open concept that includes the large living room w/gas stone facade fireplace that is currently being used as a bedroom. The formal dining area, and kitchen feature stone backsplash and accent walls w/Island & All appliances included, two large bedrooms with main bedroom featuring sliding glass doors leading out to rear deck.  Upper unit features 1 bedroom with the possibility of having two bedrooms. In unit laundry, and eat in kitchen, long term tenant who's month to month would like to stay.
